lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a staggered horizontal matrix across the posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of circular clusters to form a visible grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient between lighter dorsal pixels and shadowed lateral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple dark, elongated silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned near the ventral and lateral boundaries of the subject.
